hypotheses.P0_correct_semantic_route_transfers_to_n: Correct-family routes exceed the within-example median wrong-family route by at least 0.03 median removal projection on both corpora.
hypotheses.P1_correct_family_wins_most_new_examples: Correct-family routes beat the wrong-family median on at least 70% of new examples on both corpora.
hypotheses.P2_correct_route_is_causal_and_head_spec: Correct-family routes reach at least 0.05 median projection and beat cyclic head shifts by at least 1.5x on both corpora.
hypotheses.P3_generic_broadcast_is_sufficient: The global route is within 0.03 of the correct-family route and the correct-family advantage is below 0.03 on both corpora.
hypotheses.P4_oracle_gap_persists: The per-example oracle exceeds the better of correct-family and global routes by at least 0.05 median projection on both corpora.
